entries.notes: Unicode text and paragraph boundaries map directly; line wrapping is renderer-dependent.
A blank markup line becomes a new Word paragraph.
Typst linebreak and Word text-wrapping break are equivalent for ordinary text.
Word has several special spacing characters; Typst has richer layout spacing semantics.
Bold intent maps directly.
Italic intent maps directly.
Language tags are retained as metadata/style hints; Word does not natively syntax-highlight code.
Converted through OMML; unsupported math nodes retain raw OMML.
Display placement maps to an equation paragraph.
Levels, labels, and outline participation are retained; custom show rules are not evaluated.
Nested levels and custom bullet glyphs are supported.
Starts and common decimal/letter/Roman formats map directly.
WordprocessingML has no native definition-list element.
Content values are flattened to their materialized document tree.
Word bookmark names are sanitized to Word's identifier constraints.
Reference supplements and automatic localization may need Word field updates.
External hyperlinks and internal targets are supported.
Typst source comments are preserved only by embedded exact-roundtrip source.
Comments are source-level, not document-level Word comments.
Literal/simple expressions are parsed; arbitrary computation is preserved rather than executed.
